dct_description_sm: As part of the Internal funds from Fishiers and Environment Canada, Environmental-Social Program, Northern Pipeline from the Task Force on Northern Oil Development, and the Beaufort Sea Project, this project aimed at: 1) To provide baseline information for measuring changes that may occur due to petroleum exploration/ development. 2) To add to the accumulated data for understanding the nature and the magnitude of role of zoobenthos.
dct_title_s: Zoobenthos data from the Southern Beaufort Sea, 1971-1975
